title: The Alarm Keeps Sounding
situation: An alarm sounds during a test, and the belt stops. Alex calls Sam. They talk about when the alarm started, what the indicator shows, and whether Alex checked the sensor and the detector. Alex restarts the machine and runs a test bag, and the output returns to normal.
objective: Describe a sounding alarm, explain when a problem started, ask simple past questions, and report a successful test.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Hi, Sam. This is Alex. The alarm on my machine is sounding again.
dialogue.indonesian: Hai, Sam. Ini Alex. Alarm di mesin saya berbunyi lagi.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: I'm sorry to hear that. When did the alarm start?
dialogue.indonesian: Saya turut mendengarnya. Kapan alarmnya mulai berbunyi?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: It started two minutes ago, right after I put a test bag on the belt.
dialogue.indonesian: Alarmnya mulai dua menit yang lalu, tepat setelah saya meletakkan tas uji di belt.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: No, the belt is stopped, and the alarm is still sounding.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak, belt-nya berhenti, dan alarmnya masih berbunyi.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Okay. Is there a red indicator on the control panel?
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Apakah ada indikator merah di panel kontrol?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, there is. The indicator is red, and the display says 'Sensor error.'
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, ada. Indikatornya merah, dan layar menampilkan 'Sensor error.'

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thanks. Did you check the sensor and the detector?
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Apakah Anda sudah memeriksa sensor dan detektornya?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I checked the sensor, but I didn't check the detector yet.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sudah memeriksa sensornya, tetapi belum memeriksa detektornya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: That's okay. Please check the detector from the outside and tell me what you see. Follow the official SOP and safety rules before you check the power or open any panel.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak apa-apa. Mohon periksa detektornya dari luar dan beri tahu saya apa yang Anda lihat. Ikuti SOP resmi dan aturan keselamatan sebelum memeriksa daya atau membuka panel apa pun.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Okay. I'm looking at the detector now. It looks clean, and there is no test bag inside.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Saya sedang melihat detektornya sekarang. Detektornya terlihat bersih, dan tidak ada tas uji di dalamnya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good. Please restart the machine and run one test bag again.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Mohon mulai ulang mesinnya dan jalankan satu tas uji lagi.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I restarted the machine and ran one test bag. The belt is moving, and the alarm is not sounding now.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sudah memulai ulang mesinnya dan menjalankan satu tas uji. Belt-nya bergerak, dan alarmnya tidak berbunyi lagi sekarang.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Did the detector show an output?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, it did. The output looks normal on the display.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya. Output-nya terlihat normal di layar.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Great. Please write a short note about the alarm and the test result. Call me if it happens again. Goodbye, Alex.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Mohon tulis catatan singkat tentang alarm dan hasil pengujiannya. Hubungi saya jika itu terjadi lagi. Selamat tinggal, Alex.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Okay, I will. Thank you, Sam. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik, saya akan melakukannya. Terima kasih, Sam. Selamat tinggal.

keyExpressions.note: Present continuous untuk bunyi yang sedang berlangsung.
Simple past question dengan did + verb dasar.

keyExpressions.indonesian: Alarmnya mulai dua menit yang lalu.
keyExpressions.note: Ago dipakai untuk waktu yang sudah lewat.
Is stopped menjelaskan kondisi saat ini.
Indicator adalah lampu atau tanda status.

keyExpressions.english: I didn't check the detector yet.

keyExpressions.note: Output adalah hasil yang ditampilkan mesin.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Present continuous untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung.
Simple past question untuk menanyakan waktu kejadian.
Simple past untuk menyebut waktu lampau.

sentencePatterns.pattern: Did you + verb + noun? — I didn't + verb + noun yet.
sentencePatterns.explanation: Pertanyaan dan jawaban negatif dalam simple past.
examples: Did you check the sensor? I didn't check the detector yet.
Did you restart the machine? I didn't restart it yet.

learningNotes: Gunakan simple past untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai, misalnya The alarm started two minutes ago.
Gunakan present continuous untuk kondisi yang sedang berlangsung, misalnya The alarm is sounding.
Periksa satu bagian pada satu waktu agar laporan tetap jelas.
Follow the official SOP and safety rules before checking power or opening panels.

pronunciationNotes.title: alarm
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata kedua: uh-LARM (/əˈlɑːrm/).
